earned_statement: Continued exposure to the fixed identifying predicate field produced a reproducible positive longitudinal shift in balanced predicate accuracy, but did not reliably yield preregistered stable two-sided competence across seeds; developmental horizon alone is therefore weakened as the sufficient explanation in this fixed learner/regime.
hostile_reading: H4 beat H1 in balanced accuracy on all 6 seeds and mean H4 reached 0.7639, so exposure duration clearly changes phenotype; DOSE_HORIZON_WEAKENED must not be paraphrased as no dose effect.
Only 3 of 6 H4 seeds reached overall accuracy >=0.75 and only 3 of 6 H4 seeds achieved both truth sides >=0.65, failing the preregistered competence gate.
H4 beat H2 on only 4 of 6 seeds; continued exposure is not uniformly monotonic at the seed level.

H2 substantially improved the true side while reducing pooled false-side accuracy relative to H1, consistent with basin movement; because the preregistered rotation trigger used an undefined materiality threshold, no separate rotation disposition is mechanically promoted.
The screen is one opaque predicate, one fixed base learner, one adapter/optimizer regime; it cannot establish a universal CFE dose law.
Recovery provenance does not create extra evidence: salvaged artifacts were admitted only by hash verification, and the six-seed aggregate is the scientific unit.
mechanical_next: prioritize richer predicate-field resolution and learner-interface/decomposition discrimination; do not extend beyond H4 adaptively
next_branch_constraints: Do not rescue horizon by adding donor-derived geometry post hoc.
